sources.title: PAD-US 4.1 Geodatabase (USGS Gap Analysis Project, ScienceBase)
sources.retrieval: downloaded by hand from ScienceBase (no scriptable link)

transform.command: ogr2ogr -f Parquet combined-crs84.parquet PADUS4_1Geodatabase.gdb PADUS4_1Combined_Proclamation_Marine_Fee_Designation_Easement -t_srs OGC:CRS84 -nlt CONVERT_TO_LINEAR -nlt PROMOTE_TO_MULTI -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=SHAPE -preserve_fid -lco FID=OBJECTID -lco WRITE_COVERING_BBOX=NO -lco COMPRESSION=ZSTD

parameters.sort: features larger than a fraction of the partition last, then hilbert(bbox centre, partition extent), then id
